description: Implementation of RoleReadPlatformService for accessing role data from the database, including methods to retrieve all roles, active roles, self-service roles, a specific role by ID, and roles associated with an app user.

classes.name: RoleReadPlatformServiceImpl
classes.description: Service class implementing role data retrieval operations.

classes.name: RoleMapper
classes.description: Inner class implementing RowMapper to map SQL result set to RoleData objects.

methods.name: retrieveAll
methods.description: Retrieves all roles from the database.

methods.name: retrieveAllSelfServiceRoles
methods.description: Retrieves roles designated for self-service users.

methods.name: retrieveOne
methods.description: Retrieves a specific role by its ID.

methods.name: retrieveAppUserRoles
methods.description: Retrieves roles associated with a specific application user.
